newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-VAN DER ELST NAMED BELGIAN PLAYER OF 1996.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VAN DER ELST NAMED BELGIAN PLAYER OF 1996.

text.p: Club Brugge captain Franky Van der Elst was named Belgium's soccer player of 1996 on Wednesday.
Midfielder Van der Elst, who also won the "golden boot" trophy in 1990, polled 250 votes. Anderlecht's Swedish international Par Zetterberg was runner-up with 159.
Van der Elst, 35, retired from the Belgian national team after the 1994 World Cup finals in the United States and has since refused pleas to change his mind.
He led Club Brugge to the Belgian title and league cup double in 1996.
The trophy is awarded by a panel of journalists, soccer union officials and referees.
